channel.title: The Grassy Issue
channel.description: An independent golf blog from Austin, Texas: small golf brands, new drops, gear and public-course golf, by Lenny Harrington.

item.title: Far and Wide: Five Independent Golf Brands From Around the World, and Where to Play in Their Backyard
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Independent golf is community first. Five brands from five countries (Odd Ritual, Mogshade, ANTi COUNTRY CLUB TOKYO, Late Nine and Rouqe), their lookbooks, 30 pieces, and the course to play in each brand's backyard.

item.title: Around the Greens: 36 Ball Markers, Divot Tools, Putter Covers and Wedges
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Nine each of the best independent ball markers, divot tools, putter covers and wedges for 2026: Swell Marks, TOTEM, Walker, Fyfe, Mackem, Dormie, hand-stamped Piretti and torched Haywood wedges and more, all in stock.

item.title: Brand to Know: Radmor, the Seattle Golf Brand With No Virgin Polyester
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Radmor is a Seattle golf brand from two former University of Washington teammates: knit polos, merino and cashmere sweaters, a new rain suit and leather BobRad headcovers. 54 picks in stock, in US dollars.

item.title: Our Favorite Golf Collabs This Month: Manors x Sun Mountain, Sherwood x Dormie and More
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: The best golf collaborations of the month: Manors x Sun Mountain bags, a Paré x Minted Greens mahjong set, Sherwood hockey socks turned Dormie headcovers, Nike x Eastside Golf, Sun Day Red x VESSEL, Walker x Hiroki and more.

item.title: Fall Golf Colorways for 2026: Sage, Hunter Orange, Chocolate and 5 More Pairings
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Nine pieces in each of eight fall golf color pairings, six on trend and two that never miss: sage and ecru, hunter orange and charcoal, chocolate and cream, racing green and butter, burgundy and stone, olive and tan, navy and heather gray, camel and charcoal. 72 pieces in stock.

item.title: Feel, Look, Habit: Three Golf Brands on Our Radar (ITL Golf, Masterpiece Sports Club, 52 Sundays)
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Cabretta gloves and leather goods from a Calgary teaching pro, performance golf clothes from Masterpiece Sports Club, and tees, hats and towels from 52 Sundays. 27 picks with US prices.

item.title: Best Golf Vests for Men: 36 Picks for Fall 2026
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: The 36 best golf vests for men this fall from 30 independent brands: fleece and sherpa from Jones Sports Co, Sugarloaf and Fella, padded vests from Sounder and ANTi Country Club Tokyo, wind vests from Sentinel and SLOAT, and sweater vests from Devereux and J.Press.

item.title: Brand to Know: Paris Golf Gallery, the Showroom That Says Golf Is the New Skateboarding
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Paris Golf Gallery started as a Fashion Week showroom in Le Marais and now makes its own line: Golf Is the New Skateboarding tees, a supporter scarf, handmade ashtrays and caps with Paré, PXG and Odd Ritual. 21 picks in US dollars.

item.title: How Big Can an Independent Golf Brand Get?
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Private equity owns more of golf than most people realize. Five well-known brands, from family-owned Ping to founder-led Malbon, the hazy line in the middle, and how to know who you are buying from.

item.title: Siegelman Stable Revisited: Maxfli, the Yankees and 33 Golf-Ready Picks
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Back to Siegelman Stable: what is left of the Maxfli golf capsule, a Yankees collection with CC Sabathia, Prince caps, fall knits and hoodies for a cold course and 33 picks with US prices.

item.title: Where to Get a Little Work Done in Austin, Then Sneak in Nine
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: 15 laptop-friendly spots in Austin, from the Central Library and the Carpenter Hotel to Radio, Leona and Flightpath, each paired with the nearest course, range or simulator for after you log off.

item.title: The Best New Golf Video Games to Play When the Clocks Fall Back
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: The clocks fall back November 1. The best golf video games of the last few years, from PGA Tour 2K25 and Mario Golf: Super Rush to Super Battle Golf and Normal Golf Game, with where to play them and prices.

item.title: BEAMS Golf Revisited: Sun Day Red, the 50th and 42 New Picks
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Back to BEAMS Golf: Tiger Woods' Sun Day Red lands in Japan through BEAMS, a 50th-anniversary run of Jones, Lacoste and Baracuta specials, a Malbon archive drop and 42 picks, with yen prices.

item.title: Brand to Know: Angus & Grace Go Golfing, the Sydney Label Named for Two Westies
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Angus & Grace Go Golfing is a Sydney golf label from former P. Johnson tailor Matthew Burns, named for his two West Highland terriers. Polos, knits, shorts, trousers and GOLF DADDY caps, with prices.

item.title: Brand to Know: Pinned Golf, Rangefinders and Speakers With Better Vibes
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Pinned Golf is a Massachusetts golf tech brand started in 2018 by three friends who couldn't afford a rangefinder. The full line-up: the Prism+, the award-winning Caddie GPS tablet and Sound Stick speakers, with prices.

item.title: Brand to Know: Dicey Golf, Bet-On-Yourself Golf Clothes From Mesa, Arizona
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Dicey Golf is a Mesa, Arizona golf brand founded in 2023 on one idea: bet on yourself. $80 polos, the new Draft Day collection, casino-chip ball markers and King of Hearts headcovers, with prices.

item.title: Fyfe Golf Golden Restless Age: Harris Tweed, Lambswool and a Game of Feel
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Fyfe Golf's Golden Restless Age drop: twelve Harris Tweed, waxed canvas and leather headcovers, Scottish lambswool knits, a Glasgow-bound golfer's diary and the 24th MacKenzie x Fyfe bag. The full lookbook, with prices.

item.title: 3 Indie Golf Brands That Caught Our Eye: Swell Marks, Hinotori, Studio Grain
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Hand-engraved brass ball markers from a Navy oceanographer, Japanese-inspired gloves and headcovers from Minnesota, and caps from two friends with a YouTube channel. 23 picks with US prices.

item.title: The Graphic Tee Edit Vol. 2: 39 Golf Tees With Something to Say
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Thirty-nine graphic golf tees from 18 independent brands: big back prints from Hinotori, Dicey, Devereux and Golf Gods, plus slogans, photo prints and a $16 St Andre. Prices checked October 29, 2026.

item.title: The 12 Best Quiet Luxury Golf Brands of 2026
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: The 12 best quiet luxury golf brands of 2026, from Late Nine, Whim and Alba to Rookline, Macade, Woodgrain, Shapland and MacKenzie bags. Merino, cashmere, pleats and leather, with prices.

item.title: Brand to Know: Golden Soul Golf, Handmade Leather Headcovers From Colombia
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Golden Soul Golf makes leather, cowhide and wool headcovers by hand in Colombia, including fitted covers for LAB Golf putters. 52 pieces, from $90 alignment stick covers to woven Sunday bags, with prices.

item.title: Brand to Know: Penta Golf, Golf Clothes From Sydney's Northern Beaches
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Penta Golf is a Northern Beaches, Sydney brand started by friends from a print magazine and a youth culture agency: zip polos, Hazard shorts and a new capsule with LA's Barnaby's. All 20 pieces, with prices.

item.title: 3 Small Golf Brands: Aberdeen West, We Hit Fairways, Grind City
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: On our radar: Aberdeen West's satin jackets and golf shoes, We Hit Fairways' knit polos and Grind City's golf streetwear. Where each brand is heading, the trend they share and 27 picks with US prices.

item.title: Brand to Know: Paré Golf, Filipino Pastels and the Kid Putting in Jorts
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Paré Golf mixes golf, streetwear and Filipino culture: Philippine-flag pastels, the Paré Boy putting logo and a Manila triangle that will remind you of Prada. 36 picks, including the colorful pieces that sold out.

item.title: The Pullover Edit: 25 Quarter-Zips, Windshirts and V-Necks for Fall Golf
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: The best golf pullovers for fall: 20 new quarter-zips, windshirts and V-necks from independent brands, plus 5 vintage finds from resellers, Tiger-era Nike to the Masters. All with prices.

item.title: Golf Trips for the Mind, Body or Spirit: 15 Public Courses to Travel For
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Fifteen public golf courses built for a dedicated trip, sorted by what you need: courses that make you think, courses that test your body and courses that quiet everything down. With fees, walking rules and how to go alone.

item.title: Brand to Know: Alba Golf, Milan's New Technical Golfwear
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Alba Golf launched in Milan in October 2026: REDA merino polos, PrimaLoft vests and taped waterproof jackets from $56 to $616. All 24 pieces, and our honest take on the price.

item.title: Brand to Know: Whim Golf, American Merino and Free Golf in NYC
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Whim Golf makes merino golf shirts from sheep to shirt in the USA and runs free putting greens in New York. 16 picks from $33 to $8,800, checked Oct. 25, 2026.

item.title: East Coast vs. West Coast Golf Brands: 3 Matchups, 36 Picks
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Metalwood vs. Whim, SLOAT vs. Rookline, Jones vs. Gumtree: six independent golf brands from both coasts, side by side. You decide who wins. Prices checked Oct. 25, 2026.

item.title: The Golf Capsule Wardrobe: 5 Capsules, 52 Pieces, 20 Outfits
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Five golf capsule wardrobes from independent brands, ten or eleven interchangeable pieces each in one palette, with four outfits per capsule from a muni round to a special-day course. Prices checked October 25, 2026.

item.title: 3 Hat Makers With Momentum: Communal, Duke + Dexter, Winslow
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Three hat makers on the rise: Communal from Austin, Duke + Dexter from London and Winslow from LA. Their stories, what's driving each one right now and 18 hats with prices.

item.title: water when dry Revisited: Fall/Winter 2026 and 21 Picks
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Four months after our first look at water when dry, the Orlando label built on a garden metaphor: the fall/winter 2026 utility pants and made-to-order pullovers, golf days, a 2,000-member Discord and 21 picks from $15 to $128.

item.title: Ripstop vs Merino vs Corduroy: Golf Fabrics Explained
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Ripstop, merino wool and corduroy, explained for golfers: what each fabric is, how they compare on warmth and weather, and 24 picks from independent brands.

item.title: Jones x Cph/Golf Collab: The Full October 2026 Drop
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Jones Sports Co. and Tokyo's Cph/Golf reunite: a 90s wind breaker, mock necks, pants, caps and a Trouper stand bag, with yen and dollar prices.

item.title: New Golf Drops: Malbon x Grateful Dead, Gumtree x Wynn, Mogshade
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: This week's new golf releases: Malbon's Long Vacation drop with the Grateful Dead, Gumtree's Wynn Golf Club collab and 14 new Mogshade headcovers, with prices.

item.title: Public Drip Revisited: Nightshift, Akashi-Kama and 33 Picks
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Four months after our first look at Brooklyn's muni-born Public Drip: the Nightshift fall collection, a Japanese-textile swing vest with Akashi-Kama, new pro shops, and 33 picks from $40 to $170.

item.title: Dogs on the Golf Course: Our Take, and 29 Pieces of Golf Dog Gear
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Should you bring your dog golfing? We're all for it, carefully. Where dogs are welcome, course etiquette, and 29 golf dog collars, bandanas, bowls and headcovers.

item.title: Winter Golf Clothes From Outdoor Brands: 35 Picks
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: What to wear for cold-weather golf: 35 durable, waterproof and windproof picks from Arc'teryx, Salomon, Gramicci, Purple Mountain Observatory and Goldwin.

item.title: Saha Golf: Football-Kit Polos and Questionable Packaging
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Brand to Know: Saha Golf, a brand-new golf label with a vintage football-kit polo, a knight tee that fades on purpose, bamboo tees in a cigarette box and clean basics. Every piece, $20 to $169.

item.title: SLOAT: San Francisco Golf Clothes in Natural Fibers Only
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Brand to Know: SLOAT, a new San Francisco golf brand named for Sloat Boulevard. Organic cotton fleece, merino polos and Ventile outerwear made in Portugal, hats made in Queens. All 16 pieces, $65 to $595.

item.title: Golfer Style Inspiration: Dress Like Nelly Korda, Arnold Palmer, Min Woo Lee, Anthony Kim and Moe Norman
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Five golfers with a look of their own, and 58 pieces you can buy now that borrow from it: Korda's camo cargos, Palmer's cardigans, Min Woo Lee's mock necks, Anthony Kim's AK cap and Moe Norman's turtlenecks and too-short pants.

item.title: Gone Already: 35 Sold-Out Pieces From Independent Golf
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: A gallery of sold-out collabs, one-offs and oddities from independent golf brands: Clamp's Supreme and Louis Vuitton reworks, a $25,000 Damascus putter, Jimmy Choo x Malbon, Sentinel, Gumtree and more.

item.title: The Ultimate F1 Weekend in Austin: Golf, COTA, Texas Football
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: A no-budget US Grand Prix weekend in Austin, Oct 22-25, 2026: Barton Creek and Lost Pines golf, Paddock Club and a helicopter to COTA, Texas vs Ole Miss, Michelin-starred dinners and the race, day by day.

item.title: BUNX Golf: Rodeo Golf Hats and Overbuilt Gear From Utah
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Brand to Know: BUNX Golf, the Utah husband-and-wife brand behind Long Iron Country, the Tex and Rough Rodeo hats, magnetic towels, a forever divot tool and tees that bend instead of snapping. 22 picks, $10 to $57.

item.title: 6 UK Independent Golf Brands That Belong in the US
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Parmore, Three Putt, Son of Edmond, Casualist, Sounder and No Return Club: six independent UK golf brands that would look great on an American course. 36 picks with prices in pounds and dollars.

item.title: Criquet Revisited: Willie Forever and the Fall 2026 Line
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: We revisit Austin's Criquet: the officially licensed Willie Nelson 'Willie Forever' collection, the Coach Nelson players shirt, quilted shackets, the waxed ranch jacket and cashmere. 18 picks with prices.

item.title: Read The Green Revisited: Swish, '90s Windbreakers, New Caps
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: We revisit Read The Green: the Swish Collection with Nick Swisher, the Back '90s Windbreaker, the Fairway 1/4 Zip and the new caps. 15 fall picks from the New York brand, plus the pullover that started it, with prices.

item.title: 3 Small Golf Brands: Dim Sum, Rowena and DRVN
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Dim Sum Golf Club, Rowena Golf Club and DRVN Golf Co.: three small golf brands with three very different styles, from Hong Kong street graphics to linen trousers to milled putters. 22 picks with prices.

item.title: Golf Gear for Climbers, Anglers, Techies, Surfers and More
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Golf plus the other thing you love: gear for the climber, the techie, the fly fisherman, the vintage nut, the car person and the surfer. 36 picks from independent brands, with prices.

item.title: Loraloma Golf Club: David McLay Kidd's First Texas Course
item.dc:creator: Lenny Harrington
item.description: Loraloma in Spicewood is David McLay Kidd's first Texas course: 18 all-zoysia holes on the Pedernales River cliffs, 25 miles west of Austin.
